scope: durable Team cancellation observation and signal propagation
behavior: Scheduler creates one AbortController per claimed task.
Configured polling observes durable cancelRequested without changing claim ownership.
executeTeamTask receives the signal and stops before new journal commands.
Run and Goal terminal waits check the signal between polling intervals.
Worker close aborts in-flight scheduler executors while lease recovery remains durable.
limitations: Cancellation does not claim that an already dispatched external side effect was undone.
The production actor/authorization host remains opt-in and explicit.
No default desktop Team or autonomous sub-agent activation is claimed.
